title: House Dance Basic steps & Grooves Tutorial for Beginners | Jacking

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down house dance jacking variations with clear on-screen counts and point annotations. He demonstrates each groove from the side and front to show body levels and weight shifts.

lesson_structure.note: Boot camp day 5 introduction to jacking.
Jacking mix variation with height differences.

cues: Bend your knees with Count EN.
Open your legs sideways while jacking.
common_mistakes: Don't open your legs too much.
Do not bend your knees deeply.
Do not tilt your upper body forward too much.

steps_taught.name: Standard Jacking
steps_taught.description: Shake body back and forth to music with knee bends and upper body pulls.

steps_taught.name: Jacking Walk
steps_taught.description: Walk while maintaining the jacking groove.

steps_taught.name: Jacking Drop
steps_taught.description: Jacking with lower knee drops and hip shifts.

steps_taught.name: Jacking Mix
steps_taught.description: Jacking with height differences and upper body control.

what_works: On-screen text guides and count numbers keep the viewer oriented.
Side view angles clearly show knee bend and hip position.
what_hinders: No spoken audio instruction; depends entirely on text overlays.

quotes.text: Shake your body back and forth to the music.
Open your legs sideways while jacking.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing front demonstrating standard jacking with subtle knee bounce.
Teacher turns to side profile with numbered count overlays on screen.
Teacher demonstrates open and close legs while maintaining jacking groove.

extraction.distinctive_method: Silent tutorial relying exclusively on on-screen text instructions, step names, and animated counts combined with front and side demonstrations.
